fields.summary: Create wire exclusive SoD policy (WireInitiator vs WireApprover dual control)
fields.description:
## Background

Meridian National Bank requires payment dual control: no single identity may both initiate and approve wires. Treasury owns the business rule; IAM owns detection via IIQ SOD policy.

Clean staffing model (baseline):
- priya.wire (MNB00090) → WIRE_INIT via MNB-Role-WireInitiator / MNB-IT-WireInit (jobCode WIR01)
- marcus.approve (MNB00091) → WIRE_APPR via MNB-Role-WireApprover / MNB-IT-WireAppr (jobCode WIR02)

Matrix: lab-data/reference/sod-matrix.csv row WIRE_INIT,WIRE_APPR.
Lab lessons: 25–26 (roles), 39–40 (SoD / dual-control deep dive).
Control owner: Rachel Evans (Payments Ops) + Risk. Exception signer: rachel.evans. Standing exceptions prohibited.

## Goal

Create and enable SOD policy **MNB-SOD-Wire-DualControl** that flags any identity holding both sides of the wire exclusive pair. Prefer role-level constraints when roles exist; entitlement-level WIRE_INIT vs WIRE_APPR is acceptable if role SOD is unavailable.

## Scope (in)

1. Inventory existing SOD policies (list_sod_policies) — do not duplicate if MNB-SOD-Wire-DualControl already exists and is correct.
2. Inventory wire roles: MNB-Role-WireInitiator, MNB-Role-WireApprover, MNB-IT-WireInit, MNB-IT-WireAppr (list_agent_roles).
3. Create policy MNB-SOD-Wire-DualControl if missing (create_sod_policy) with:
   - Left: Wire Initiator side (role MNB-Role-WireInitiator and/or entitlement WIRE_INIT on WirePortal / IT inventory)
   - Right: Wire Approver side (role MNB-Role-WireApprover and/or entitlement WIRE_APPR)
   - Severity: High/Critical
   - Description: Payment dual control — initiate vs approve; FFIEC dual-control expectation for payment systems
4. Set/update constraints (update_sod_constraints) so left/right sets match above exactly.
5. Simulate (simulate_sod_policy) for:
   - Clean: priya.wire (expect no violation)
   - Clean: marcus.approve (expect no violation)
   - Toxic (optional lab-only): identity temporarily holding both — expect violation; restore after
6. Run Identity Refresh with policy check (run_task_now) if simulation alone is insufficient.
7. list_open_sod_violations — confirm Priya/Marcus are clean; document any real hits for Risk.
8. Evidence under .ai-delivery/<KEY>/: policy name/id, constraint payload, simulation results, violation list, role inventory.

## Scope (out)

- Do not create standing/permanent exceptions.
- Do not mitigate without rachel.evans signoff + ≤30 day expiry + compensating control (escalate as blocked-needs-human).
- Do not call update_rule_source, update_scope, or grant_capability.
- Do not auto-transition Jira to Done.
- Do not leave induced toxic access on shared lab identities.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Policy MNB-SOD-Wire-DualControl exists and is enabled
- [ ] Constraints enforce exclusive Wire Initiator vs Wire Approver (roles and/or WIRE_INIT vs WIRE_APPR)
- [ ] Simulation/refresh shows priya.wire and marcus.approve clean when split
- [ ] Open violations reviewed; no unexplained wire dual-control hits on the clean pair
- [ ] Evidence pack + handoff comment for In Review (how to re-test documented)
- [ ] Business roles still SoD-safe: no business role Requires both WireInit and WireAppr IT packs (flag if found; remediate via set_role_requirements only if in DoR)

## MCP tools

list_sod_policies, create_sod_policy, update_sod_constraints, simulate_sod_policy, list_open_sod_violations, list_agent_roles, run_task_now, get_task_result, search_identities, get_identity_roles / get_identity_access

## DoR checklist

- [ ] Policy name agreed: MNB-SOD-Wire-DualControl
- [ ] Left/right objects named (roles and/or entitlements)
- [ ] Personas for clean baseline: priya.wire, marcus.approve
- [ ] mutateGovernanceEnabled true on toolkit for SOD writes
- [ ] Label agent-ready + policy-sod

- docs/lessons/39-sod-fundamentals.md, 40-payment-dual-control-policy.md
- docs/lessons/25-dept-job-roles.md, 26-it-role-packaging.md
